title: H1 injectivity lifts a generator over the Picard intersection
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $f_i:X_i\to S$ ($1\le i\le n$) be flat, proper morphisms of finite presentation [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-scheme-over-base, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and let $u_i:X_i\to X$ be morphisms over $S$. Assume that for every morphism $T\to S$, the canonical maps $\mathcal O_T\to (f_T)_*\mathcal O_{X_T}$ and $\mathcal O_T\to ((f_i)_T)_*\mathcal O_{(X_i)_T}$ are isomorphisms [def-pc-base-change, lem-sc-picard-diagonal-locally-closed]. Let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible module on $X$ [def-sc-invertible-module], let $\mathcal L_i=u_i^*\mathcal L$ be its pullback to $X_i$ [def-pc-module-pullback], and let $Z$ and $Z_i$ be the locally closed subschemes of $S$ representing the loci where $\mathcal L$ and $\mathcal L_i$ are pulled back from the base. Suppose $s\in Z$ and $s\in Z_i$ for every $i$, and the joint pullback map $H^1(X_s,\mathcal O_{X_s})\to\prod_i H^1(X_{i,s},\mathcal O_{X_{i,s}})$ is injective [def-sc-structure-sheaf-cohomology-pullback]. Then there are an open $U\subset S$ containing $s$, a scheme $W$, an immersion $k:W\to S$ and $w\in W$ with $k(w)=s$, such that for every $g:T\to S$ whose image lies in $U$, factorization through $k$ is equivalent to factorization through all $Z_i$. On $X_W=X\times_S W$ [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-fibre-product], writing $L_W=\mathrm{pr}_X^*L$ [def-pc-module-pullback], there is a section $\sigma\in\Gamma(X_W,L_W)$ nonvanishing at every $x$ with $\mathrm{pr}_W(x)=w$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. No local triviality or equality with $Z$ is asserted.

proof.text: The proved private finiteImmersionIntersection helper inducts on n. For n=0 use S and its identity. In the successor step pull back the intersection of the tail along ji(0); the first projection followed by the tail immersion is an immersion. The pullback lift and its projection equations prove that its factorization functor is the simultaneous factorization functor.

Lift the residue-field point of s through each ji using the proved source-library exists_comp_eq_of_mem_range (surjectivity on stalks). Apply the intersection universal property to these lifts to obtain q:Spec kappa(s)->W; put w=q(default). Evaluating q composed with k gives k(w)=s. Evaluating hZi at k and its identity factorization produces hLi. Lift the same residue-field point through j using hs and evaluate hZ to obtain hLs.

Apply picard_h1_local_section_of_base_descent with the constructed immersion, w, hLi, hLs and the unchanged cohomology injection. This supplies an open V in W containing w and a section on X times_S V nonvanishing at every point over w. This is the remaining cohomological part, not an assertion of intersection representability.

Use k.isEmbedding.isInducing.isOpen_iff to obtain an ambient open U of S with k^{-1}(U)=V. Since k(w)=s and w lies in V, s lies in U. The immersion V.ι composed with k and the point (w,hwV) give the required W and marked point. A factorization through this composite factors through k. Conversely, for g with range in U, a factorization a through k has range in V; IsOpenImmersion.lift along V.ι and lift_fac lift a to V. Combining with the intersection universal property proves the exact required equivalence. The supplied section and its fibrewise nonvanishing apply without transport.
